items.title: P&G Gillette finalized the 232 A Street purchase for its new Boston headquarters and innovation center
items.description: Breakthrough Properties reported that the 232 A Street development site sale to P&G Gillette is finalized for a planned roughly 325,000-square-foot Grooming Headquarters and Technical Innovation Center. This is a concrete project milestone, but no specific vendor procurement is stated.

items.title: Autonodyne is building a Boston autonomy demonstration center and expects to source most project work locally
items.description: Massachusetts awarded Autonodyne $1 million toward a roughly 6,500-square-foot demonstration laboratory and classroom in Boston. The state says the project includes IT, HVAC, simulators and related buildout, and that the company anticipates sourcing most project work from Massachusetts-based vendors. The announcement does not identify specific open vendor packages.
why: State announcement says most project work is expected from Massachusetts vendors
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: Reframe Systems is opening a new Billerica microfactory after raising $40 million
items.description: Reframe Systems announced $40 million in new financing and said its FAB1 microfactory in Billerica will begin operations October 5. The company says the facility is designed for up to 500 multifamily units or 250 single-family homes annually with less than $5 million of equipment. No specific vendor solicitation is stated.

items.title: CPS Technologies leased an 80,000-square-foot Attleboro manufacturing facility
items.description: CPS Technologies signed a long-term lease for about 80,000 square feet in Attleboro and plans to relocate corporate offices, manufacturing and product development during 2027. A construction period runs through May 31, 2027; no specific vendor package is stated as open.

items.title: Nordstrom Rack is preparing its 23,700-square-foot Mansfield store for an October 29 opening
items.description: Nordstrom Rack's official openings page lists Mansfield Crossing for October 29, and Nordstrom Careers is actively recruiting for the new-store launch. Plymouth opened September 3, so this record now focuses on the still-forward-looking Mansfield location. No local vendor solicitation is stated.
why: Active new-store recruiting confirms launch preparations

items.title: Synergy received a $4 million state award for the 294 Washington office-to-housing conversion
items.description: Massachusetts awarded $4 million in Commercial Conversion Tax Credits to Synergy for adaptive reuse of a historic Financial District office building into 255 rental homes and about 12,000 square feet of retail. The award is a concrete project milestone, not an open vendor solicitation.
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Housing and Livable Communities

items.title: 7th Street Burger confirmed two more Greater Boston locations, with Saugus targeting October
items.location: 880 Broadway, Saugus, MA and 37 Brattle Street, Cambridge, MA
items.description: 7th Street Burger confirmed new locations in Saugus and Harvard Square. The 46-seat Saugus restaurant is on track for October 2026, while the 22-seat Cambridge location is expected in the first half of 2027 and still has a Cambridge special-permit hearing scheduled for September 10. No vendor solicitation is stated.
why: Two-location Massachusetts expansion confirmed by company marketing
Cambridge location has an active permitting milestone
items.sourceName: What Now Boston / Cambridge Board of Zoning Appeal

items.title: Bicara Therapeutics signed for a 35,090-square-foot new Boston headquarters
items.description: Bicara Therapeutics disclosed a sub-sublease for about 35,090 square feet at 10 St. James Avenue for its new corporate headquarters, with a targeted commencement on or after October 1. This creates a defined pre-move window but is not an announced vendor procurement.

items.title: STRONG Pilates is preparing three Greater Boston studios, with Back Bay and Fenway set for November 7
items.location: 10 Park Plaza and 650 Beacon Street, Boston, MA; 165 Main Street, Cambridge, MA
items.description: STRONG Pilates is entering Massachusetts with three Greater Boston studios. Fresh reporting says the Back Bay and Fenway locations are on track to open November 7, while the Kendall Square opening date is still to be announced. The multi-site launch creates plausible fit-out and operating-service needs, but no local vendor solicitation is stated.
why: Two studios have a specific November 7 opening date
Specialized connected fitness equipment and studio infrastructure

items.title: Tori Japan is preparing four new Greater Boston restaurants
items.location: Boston, Malden, Taunton and Dorchester, MA
items.description: Tori Japan confirmed plans for four Massachusetts-area restaurants. The first, near Boston University, is expected in late September, with Malden and Taunton targeted around year-end. No vendor solicitation is stated.

items.title: WinnCompanies launched a $41.5 million rehabilitation of Chicopee Village Townhomes
items.description: WinnCompanies acquired the 290-unit Chicopee Village Townhomes and launched a $41.5 million rehabilitation expected to run through summer 2028. Planned work includes roofs, windows, siding, paving, heating systems, apartment kitchens and bathrooms, accessibility upgrades and community-space modernization. No open subcontract package is stated.
why: Multiple specified building and infrastructure workstreams

items.title: Colleges of the Fenway is accepting business vendors for its September 11 Block Party
items.location: Emmanuel College Quad, 400 Fenway, Boston, MA
items.description: Colleges of the Fenway is offering vendor registration for its September 11 Block Party at Emmanuel College, a cross-campus event expected to reach students from five member institutions. The official page lists a $200 vendor registration fee, with waived fees for nonprofits and possible in-kind arrangements for food or drink providers. This is an explicit promotional vendor opportunity, not a procurement contract.
why: Official vendor registration is currently offered
September 11 event provides an immediate outreach window
Five-college consortium gives vendors access to a large student audience

items.title: Forman Mills is opening its first Springfield store on September 17
items.description: Forman Mills says it will open its first Springfield location on September 17. The large-format retail launch creates plausible site-service needs but no local vendor solicitation is stated.

items.title: Hawksmoor is opening a 280-seat Boston restaurant on September 8
items.description: Current reporting confirms Hawksmoor's first Boston restaurant is scheduled to open September 8 in Fort Point with roughly 280 seats. The launch suggests recurring operating needs but does not confirm a vendor solicitation.

items.title: Fjällräven & Co. is making its global retail-concept debut on Newbury Street
items.description: Fenix Outdoor announced the opening of the first Fjällräven & Co. store at 304 Newbury Street in Boston, with grand-opening events scheduled September 11-13. The company also recently relocated its separate Fjällräven Brand Store to 165 Newbury Street. No local vendor solicitation is stated.
why: Two recently opened or relocated Newbury Street retail locations

items.title: LPM Restaurant & Bar is preparing its public opening at Four Seasons One Dalton for September 25
items.description: Fresh reporting says LPM Restaurant & Bar is softly open for Four Seasons hotel guests and is slated to open to the public September 25. The roughly 80-seat restaurant is LPM's first Northeast U.S. location. No vendor solicitation is stated.
why: Public opening now reported for September 25
Breakfast, lunch and dinner operation inside a luxury hotel

items.title: SMC is expanding its Devens medical-device manufacturing campus
items.description: Massachusetts awarded SMC $1.25 million to renovate its existing 330,000-square-foot Devens facility and construct a new 100,000-square-foot building. The state-backed capital project includes HVAC, power and manufacturing-system work.
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Executive Office of Economic Development

items.title: West Acton Oktoberfest is accepting visiting-vendor applications through September 9
items.description: The West Acton Village Merchants Association is publicly accepting visiting-vendor applications for its September 26 Oktoberfest. Applications and payment are due September 9. This is an explicit vendor opportunity subject to organizer approval and event rules.
why: September 26 event provides a defined selling window

items.title: Brooks Running is preparing its first Massachusetts standalone store in Boston's Back Bay
items.description: Brooks Running and the Lyrik development have confirmed a new Brooks store at 408 Newbury Street for fall 2026, and Brooks has recently recruited specifically for the new Boston store. The opening creates plausible retail operating needs, but no local vendor solicitation is stated.
why: Recent new-store hiring confirms active launch preparations

items.title: Slick City is preparing its first New England action park in Milford
items.description: Slick City's first New England indoor action park is expected to open in Milford in September, and the official location page remains marked coming soon with active recruiting. No vendor solicitation is stated.
why: Official page remains coming soon with active recruiting

items.title: Umami Taqueria is preparing a second location inside Allston's Novo Marketplace
items.description: Umami Taqueria is preparing a second location at Novo Marketplace in Allston. Co-owner Quang Nguyen said the restaurant is expected to open in about a month, with timing dependent on equipment arrival and installation. No vendor solicitation is stated.
why: Opening is expected in roughly one month
Equipment arrival and installation are still active pre-opening dependencies

items.title: The Market Al Fresca has started construction on its second location in North Andover
items.description: The Market Al Fresca announced a second location at The Crossroads Retail Center in North Andover and says construction is already underway. An opening date has not yet been announced, so this is an active buildout signal rather than a confirmed purchasing opportunity.
why: Specialty food-market format implies a meaningful physical buildout
